title: Vault
description: HashiCorp Vault (or OpenBao) connection details, used by the Transit KEK and by private CAs backed by Vault's PKI secrets engine.

address.title: Address
address.description: Vault's base URL. Required once any other field below is set.

namespace.title: Namespace
namespace.description: Vault Enterprise namespace. Leave empty for open-source Vault or OpenBao.

authMethod.title: Authentication method
authMethod.description: How CertForge logs in to Vault.

token.title: Token
token.description: Vault token, used when the authentication method is token.

roleId.title: Role ID
roleId.description: AppRole role id, used when the authentication method is approle.

secretId.title: Secret ID
secretId.description: AppRole secret id, used when the authentication method is approle.

caPem.title: CA bundle
caPem.description: Additional PEM-encoded certificates trusted for Vault's TLS, appended to the system root pool.

timeoutSeconds.title: Timeout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: Per-request timeout for calls to Vault.
